description: A unit is one dwelling, suite or tenancy of a building that holds several (an apartment, a condo, a hotel room, a shop): a named group of rooms (zones) under the building. Its members may span levels (a duplex). A zone belongs to at most one unit; a zone in no unit is common area (a corridor, a lobby, the stairs). A single-family house has no units. Create one in a building, named as a person would (Apartment 2B, Suite 301, Shop 1), with the rooms it holds; add or change them later with set_unit_members.

buildingId.description: The building. Default: the building of the floor the person is viewing, else the scene's only building.

color.description: #rrggbb tint of the unit in the plan (default Pascal’s).

kind.description: What the unit is: apartment (a dwelling: a flat, a condo, one side of a duplex), hotel-room (a suite or guest room), commercial (a shop, an office, a lot let on its own), common (shared space grouped on purpose). Default apartment.

memberZoneIds.description: The rooms the unit holds, by zone ids from get_zones or create_room, on any level of the building. A zone already in another unit is refused (zone_in_other_unit, naming that unit) unless move is true.

move.description: true: a zone already in another unit leaves that unit for this one.

name.description: The unit as a person names it: Apartment 2B, Suite 301, Shop 1.

name: create_unit
title: Create unit
